table_title: Temperature (°F) of water, water year October 1966 to September 1967
location_text: Lat 37°37'24", long 121°45'28", temperature recorder at gaging station in Valle de San Jose Grant, 900 feet downstream from highway bridge, 1.1 miles upstream from Dry Creek, 4.1 miles south of Livermore, Alameda County, and 6.9 miles southeast of Pleasanton.
quantities_units: water temperature, daily maximum and minimum (°F)
notes: Page is printed sideways in the report (page number 116 rotated at left) but the scan reads upright. Water temperature at a stream gaging station: typed Water Quality (the page is from a quality-of-water record: chemical analyses, temperature, sediment); a reader could argue Stream Discharge because the site is a stream gage. First readings Oct. 27, 1966; last Sept. 25, 1967.
